title: Southern Blotting Probes for HBV Genotype D
author: Fumihiko Takeuchi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xggfjtw

steps.title: Prepare Probe Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 9 tubes for ccc1-9 probes and mix the reagents, ensuring that primer sets are not mixed (e.g., do not mix ccc1 fwd with ccc3 rev).

steps.title: Purify PCR Product
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting PCR product using ethanol purification and gel extraction.
